cmd:
echo ===DATE===; date -u
echo ===PS===; ps aux | grep -E "python3|vps_.*pipeline" | grep -v grep
echo ===CRON===; crontab -l 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^#"
echo ===SYSTEMD-AGENT===; systemctl is-active vps-agent 2>/dev/null
echo ===SYSTEMD-CADDY===; systemctl is-active caddy 2>/dev/null
echo ===TAIL-MAIN===; tail -40 /var/log/vps-pipeline.log
echo ===TAIL-AI===; tail -25 /var/log/vps-ai-pipeline.log 2>/dev/null
echo ===TAIL-SAT===; tail -15 /var/log/vps-satellite-pipeline.log
echo ===ERR-GREP-MAIN===; grep -iE "429|error|traceback|exception" /var/log/vps-pipeline.log | tail -20
